description: Look up a delivery city_id by name across Russia and the CIS (Kazakhstan, Belarus, Armenia, Kyrgyzstan). Call this first whenever the customer is outside Moscow (default city_id is 414 = Moscow). Pass the returned city_id into search_products, get_product_details, cart tools, estimate_delivery, search_pickup_points and checkout for local currency and exact delivery dates.

query.description: City name query (at least 2 characters, Russian preferred, e.g. 'Казань', 'Санкт-Петербург', 'Алматы').

name: search_cities

city_id.description: Pass as city_id to search_products, get_product_details, cart tools, estimate_delivery, search_pickup_points, and checkout.

country.description: Country code: ru, kz, by, am, kg.

is_local_courier.description: True for Moscow-area cities served by the store's own courier.
